newsitem.title: LATVIA: Unibanka slips further on Latvian share market.
newsitem.headline: Unibanka slips further on Latvian share market.

text.p: Shares in leading bank Unibanka came under more pressure on Wednesday, slipping to 1.85 lats from 2.15 amid lower than usual trade, the Riga stock exchange said.
It turned over 7,142 lats out of overall market business of 43,080 lats.
Riga Transport Fleet, the other share on the official list, was more heavily traded, seeing volume of 8,240 lats and rising a touch to 1.03 lats from 1.01.
The secondary list was dominated by Rigas Raugs yeast plant which gained further, rising to 1.92 lats from 1.67 lats on a healthy turnover of 19,522 lats.
Fish cannery Kaija turned over 3,417 lats of stock and dipped to 1.25 lats from 1.46 lats and the Daugavpils machine chain factory had activity of 1,560 lats and rose to 63 santimes from 55.
